side.prompt:
Generate one transparent 4×4 sprite sheet of sixteen complete full-body cels for a single walking loop in RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE. The character is the same compact dark-haired campus student in the first reference, with the exact original clothing, face, silhouette and crisp pixel art. The second reference is the old library side walk, for how his legs swing and recover. Draw him in a relaxed walk at the game's slightly elevated view, with natural counter-swing of both arms and a steady character design.
The grid is chronological in row-major order. The top two rows show a step led by the leg NEAREST the viewer, then the bottom two rows show the corresponding step led by the OTHER leg. Top-left contact pose: near shoe is ahead of the hip toward screen right, far shoe is behind; near arm swings behind and far arm swings forward. At the start of row three, the FAR shoe is ahead toward screen right and the near shoe is behind, with the NEAR arm swinging forward. Both contact poses must read as opposite legs taking the lead. Normal shading and overlap make the near and far limbs identifiable while retaining matching trousers and shoes. In each half, progress naturally through foot load, the other foot passing low and then extending. Continuous moderate pace, natural shifts of weight and posture. Keep him facing right in all 16 complete cels, transparent gutters, no text, no grid lines, no props or shadows.
